whyItMatters: Detects addition or reactivation of non-access-key IAM credentials (UploadSSHPublicKey, CreateServiceSpecificCredential, ResetServiceSpecificCredential, UpdateAccessKey activation). Adds Additional Cloud Credentials (T1098.001) coverage for credential types beyond the existing SigmaHQ CreateAccessKey backdoor rule and the S3Browser login-profile rule.
